short: Gases such as carbon dioxide trap heat in the atmosphere, a bit like the glass roof of a greenhouse, so the Earth stays warmer than it would otherwise be.
long: Gases such as carbon dioxide trap heat in the atmosphere, a bit like the glass roof of a greenhouse, so the Earth stays warmer than it would otherwise be.
